title: Preserve physical PCs with compact residual-block compilation
body:
The physical compiler currently materializes every residual block tuple before the caller can fetch by `(mode, pc)`. This adds an opt-in, source-authenticated streaming sink that retains one descriptor per block run while preserving the original PC domain, operation fields and every original `Residual` identity. The frozen emitter and `Machine` sources remain unchanged.

The refinement addresses the explicit emitter/continuation follow-up from #4758, rather than extending its wrapper interning. The written simulation includes rank/select, finite header lengths, `pc+1` parking, restored-mode fetch, immutable plans and stable-source observer boundaries. Mutable plans, unsupported emitter shape, wrong block identity/order and incomplete segments reject. Block fetch includes a full structural plan check, so its cost is **O(log regions + log commands + plan size)**.

Evidence is scoped:

- Independent original `Cursor` enumeration: 122 cases / 713 labels; complete two-replica GL2 words in both modes (963 / 123 instructions), with original-wrapper identity checks and a separate unchanged-emitter comparison.
- Real two-level physical caller on the first two GL2 lows, four rows and all 256 addresses per row: 1,024 bits, four calls/returns, 20 residuals, 675 macros. Original and compact runs agree on the independent payload oracle, parking/codec counters, borrowed streams/counts, full cleanup and mode-1 return PCs 4/7/14/17. An actual restored-PC corruption is rejected by the added verification guard before dispatch.
- Local CPython 3.12.2 / macOS arm64, mode 0, 64 source replicas: 30,723 instruction tuples become 3,843 retained entries, plus 12 plan indexes / 186 prefix entries. Measured compile peak, including new snapshot/index allocation, falls from 4,591,352 to 2,055,080 bytes, but compile time rises from 0.062 to 0.633 seconds. This is one local observation, **not a speed improvement**. Axis-only mode keeps its entry count and adds metadata.

Registered normal and `-O` replay, metadata/pins, exact committed-byte/source-history preflight and the 102-file committed export integrity check pass. Both normal and optimized direct replays of the extracted export also pass with fresh bytecode-cache namespaces and Git absent from PATH. The registered commands have 180 seconds each and use the standard library. No historical suite, old 9,216-bit replay, Lean, Docker, GL64 materialization, cold selected-loader admission, stock coefficient, tariff or kappa change is claimed. This remains a scoped Python refinement and finite execution, not a complete multiplication theorem or selected-frontier update.

Task `selected-stock-envelope`, revision 7, records the changed scope and why the #4758 handoff matters. Canonical claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-19131513 . Entry overlap covered 299 open PRs, 3,695 Discussion records and 6,319 tracked local notes; exact scoped search found the distinct wrapper-sharing and residual/CALL predecessors, not the same implementation. This coverage is not a novelty certificate. Source base is canonical main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`.

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml for the physical compiler/caller/Cursor and fixtures; Kewin Talaga/PellaML for source authentication and visitation audits; Nick Petalas and residual/CALL contributors for the refinement lineage; David Arias, ywz65 and retained notices. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Open next questions cover enforced immutable ownership, avoiding block enumeration, and actual selected admission.

Submission refresh: canonical main was fetched again at 2026-10-22 19:57 UTC and remains `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, with governing guidance and source inputs unchanged. The completed 19:59 overlap snapshot covers 316 open PRs and 3,732 Discussion records; a scoped local search includes all 6,319 base notes plus this package. Matches identify this claim and established, distinct itinerary predecessors, not an overlapping compressed physical-PC implementation. This is bounded coverage, not a novelty certificate.
